name: BCA American Express Platinum Card

fees.condition: waived in the first year for Rp 300.000.000 spent within 3 months of activation, and waived outright for a BCA Prioritas or BCA Solitaire customer

notes: Earning looks generous and is not: 5 Membership Rewards per Rp 1.000 sounds like a lot, but 750.000 points buy only 20.000 miles. That is 37,5 points a mile, which works out at Rp 7.500 a mile — middling, and the two figures agree exactly, which is what confirms the reading.
The published 750.000 for 20.000 reduces to 75 points for 2 miles, which is what the entry records and why the transfer step is 75.
A point is also worth Rp 1 as cashback at partner merchants, credited on the next bill. That is recorded as the cash value, so the app can compare converting against spending the points outright.

Converting is limited to 40.000 miles every three months. The schema holds a ceiling that resets monthly or yearly, and three months is neither, so no ceiling is applied and a large balance is shown converting in full.
Only KrisFlyer and GarudaMiles are recorded. Hilton Honors is sometimes listed as a partner for this card but no ratio for it could be pinned down, so an estimate for it shows nothing.
The annual fee of Rp 12.000.000 is the highest in this catalogue, and the first-year waiver asks for Rp 300.000.000 of spending. A BCA Prioritas or Solitaire customer pays nothing.

Not modelled: the point multiplier campaigns BCA runs, which carry low ceilings and often require a supplementary card, and the lounge and travel benefits. None of them is simple enough to record from what could be read.
This is the Platinum charge card. BCA issues other American Express cards, and if the card in hand is one of those, this entry is wrong throughout.
No source could be read directly. BCA's own site, americanexpress.com, PinterPoin and IndoMiles are unreachable from here, so every figure comes from search summaries.
